extensionDescription.message: Adds an option to right-click menu that downloads the link with put.io.

downloadMenuItem.description: Title of context menu item that downloads the selected link.

downloadPageMenuItem.description: Title of context menu item that downloads the current page.

welcomeNotificationMessage.message: You can use the right click menu for downloading items to your put.io account!!

transferStartNotificationTitle.description: Title of the transfer start notification

transferStartNotificationMessage.message: We are starting your transfer. You can click this message and go to your transfers page
transferStartNotificationMessage.description: Body of the transfer start notification

transferFailureNotificationTitle.description: Title of the transfer failure notification

transferFailureNotificationMessage.message: We are unable to download that :-/
transferFailureNotificationMessage.description: Description of the transfer failure notification

authUnavailableTitle.description: Notification title when sign-in validation cannot reach the service.

authUnavailableMessage.message: We could not check your sign-in. Try again in a few minutes.
authUnavailableMessage.description: Recovery text after a temporary validation failure; stored credentials are retained.

pendingTransferTitle.description: Notification title for the single link saved while sign-in is pending.

pendingTransferMessage.message: A link is already waiting. Click to retry that link before choosing another.
pendingTransferMessage.description: Clicking this notification retries the saved link; a new link has not replaced it.

authCancelledTitle.description: Notification title after cancelled, rejected, or exhausted sign-in.

authCancelledMessage.message: No transfer was started. Use the context menu to try again.
authCancelledMessage.description: The saved action was cleared without starting a transfer; choose the link again to retry.

transferUncertainTitle.description: Notification title when the server may have accepted the download request.

transferUncertainMessage.message: This download may already have started. Click to check your transfers before trying again.
transferUncertainMessage.description: Clicking opens transfers for inspection; the extension will not automatically resend this request.
